2609.22067.title: Value-Sensitive Delegation in Everyday AI Agent Use: Evidence from OpenClaw
2609.22067.paper_summary: Users increasingly delegate work to autonomous AI agents, yet evaluations typically measure task completion rather than the values users prioritize. Using Value Sensitive Design, we analyzed, with LLM assistance, 73,093 first-person Reddit posts about using OpenClaw, each for its human value, agent aspect, value fulfillment, and user outcome. The 21 values form six value groups, including Autonomous, Dependable, and Affordable Operation, Bounded Reach, Reviewability, and Equitable Access. Relative to each aspect's corpus share, values clustered not at the agent's outputs but at the operating conditions users set around a run. Values were usually met where users described what the agent delivered, in five of six groups, and mostly unmet where users described supervising it, in all six groups. We conceptualize this pattern as value-sensitive delegation. Supporting human values requires attention not only to what an agent accomplishes, but to the conditions users set around delegation, including cost, access, and oversight.
2609.22067.paper_summary_zh: 使用者越來越多地將工作委託給自主的 AI 代理，但評估通常測量的是任務完成情況，而不是使用者所重視的價值。利用價值敏感設計，我們在 LLM 的協助下分析了 73,093 條關於使用 OpenClaw 的第一人稱 Reddit 文章，針對其人類價值、代理特徵、價值滿足和使用者結果進行分析。這 21 種價值形成了六個價值群體，包括自主、可靠和可負擔的運作、有限的範圍、可審查性和公平的訪問。相對於每個方面的語料庫份額，價值的聚集並不在代理的輸出上，而是在使用者為執行設定的操作條件上。當使用者描述代理所提供的內容時，通常能滿足價值，這在六個群體中的五個群體中均為如此；而當使用者描述監督代理時，在所有六個群體中則大多數未滿足。我們將這種模式概念化為價值敏感的委託。支持人類價值不僅需要關注代理所達成的結果，還需要關注使用者在委託過程中設定的條件，包括成本、訪問和監督。
